verdict.rationale: The Gemini API's own discovery document shows an explicitly versioned REST surface ("version": "v1beta"), so API versioning exists in the product. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or migration guarantees, and the only version shown is a beta. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, stable (non-beta) version evidence, model/API sunset timelines, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Go from a quick prompt to production apps and agents with the Gemini API.
